acks.note: The map kit can now trace a country: a bright line with a glowing head runs round its border and closes on the word that names it, then stays lit (flat/map.tsx `trace`); the director now does this for every country a line is about.

Flags: the kit draws about 60 national flags as a country's fill; from tonight half the Shorts cover the country with its flag and half keep the colour (geo-flag-fill, this channel's weekly cycle 1, judged on viewers held after the hook); the winner stays. Famous people: the director now stands every named person (Napoleon) on the map as their photo head when a freely licensed photo exists.
